about_the_game:
YTASH is a Metroidvania set in the world of Nocturnal, where you play as Ardeshir, a master of the Enduring Flame, determined to explore and awaken the city of Ytash and its dormant mechanisms.

But what sleeps is reluctant to wake, and the night that shrouds the city will unleash creatures bent on extinguishing all living flames

Features:

  • Carry your flames across the island, avoiding anything that could extinguish them.

  • Master a fast-paced and push-forward combat system to stay on the offensive.

  • Use your blade to rekindle ancient mechanisms and torches, gradually awakening Ytash.

  • Build up your fire bar to unleash a powerful burnout mode.

  • Collect fragments of a lost poem, uncovering the story of a city that consumed itself long ago.

  • Unlock signature moves to enhance both your platforming and combat abilities.

  • Explore a compact island offering a streamlined adventure focused on a singular concept, with many secrets waiting to be uncovered.
